text: At its meeting on Thursday, April 25, 2024, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR5.4 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 5, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: Enterprise Risk Management is a continuous process to identify and assess risks and opportunities at an enterprise level. The Toronto Parking Authority currently does not have a formal Enterprise Risk Management strategy and after the release of a Request for Proposals in the second quarter of 2023, the successful proponent, KPMG LLP (KPMG), was engaged to support the setup of the Enterprise Risk Management Program.
